map.数字和日期怎么变了？: Why did my numbers and dates change?
map.CSV 是无类型的，所有值都是字符串。转换时若自动推断类型，可能把手机号变成数字: CSV is untyped — every value is a string. When type inference is enabled during conversion, a phone number may become a number and lose precision, 010 may become 10, and 2024-01-02 may be parsed into a date object. To preserve fidelity, turn type inference off, or specify each field type explicitly after conversion.
